label_policy: multi_label; empty labels means unresolved, not safe

codebook.inclusion_rule: An explicit data, API, preparation-state, or connectivity prerequisite governs initialization, delivery, or resumed execution. Mere owner-validity checks and listener-before-start ordering are not additionally counted as readiness.
Explicit ordering between distinct operations or state consistency across synchronous callbacks. A return/completion barrier alone belongs to B, and a readiness dependency alone belongs to R.
codebook.name_zh: 前置顺序与重入一致性

codebook.inclusion_rule: An explicitly required submission, persistence, cleanup, or paint-completion stage precedes a public return, handoff, or dependent effect. Ordinary asynchronous decoding and checking a service's ready status alone are not counted as this family.
Resource ownership, visit/attempt retirement, cancellation, terminal state, or component disposal governs work admission, cleanup, or effect permission.
codebook.name_zh: 生命周期约束下的接纳与副作用

codebook.inclusion_rule: An effect retains its entry document, request, attempt, visit, or committed terminal-value binding across an intervening transition. A static business ID or adjacent-owner contrast alone is insufficient.
Competing results within a retained logical owner are ordered by arrival or edit revision. Suppression solely because an old visit or attempt was retired is counted under L/I, not F.
codebook.name_zh: 结果新鲜度与版本一致性

codebook.inclusion_rule: A declared accepted-work retention, no-loss, no-duplication, idempotence, or per-activation effect-count requirement is directly exercised. Generic output equality in unrelated regression tests is insufficient.
codebook.name_zh: 已接纳工作保留与效果次数约束

mechanism_predicates.shared_lifetime: 修复对象的共享状态或工作可超出单个消费者寿命
mechanism_predicates.observer_lifetime: 多个消费者通过独立订阅/观察者身份共享同一工作
mechanism_predicates.attempt_resource: 每次执行尝试有独立取消资源或完成身份
mechanism_predicates.lazy_consumption: 读取取消能力会同步记录实际消费，且其归属可由当前证据核查
mechanism_predicates.async_resume: 暂停/重试工作可通过异步续行恢复
mechanism_predicates.deferred_batch: 修复对象将连续输入合并为可挂起的延迟工作
mechanism_predicates.boundary_persistence: 当前文档规定离开/提交边界返回前须结算已接纳的持久化义务
mechanism_predicates.entry_snapshot: 接纳的操作绑定入口选择/数据，后续重入不应改写其既成义务
mechanism_predicates.inline_reentry: 结算/通知会同步调用可重入导航/编辑的回调
mechanism_predicates.effect_lifetimes: 持久结果和当前界面反馈具有可区分的归属与有效期
mechanism_predicates.different_ownership_policy: 当前任务明确要求与共享状态及尝试分离相矛盾的所有权政策
mechanism_predicates.discard_boundary_policy: 当前任务明确允许丢弃目标的已接纳持久义务而非结算
mechanism_predicates.no_lazy_shared_mechanism: 当前证据明确表明修复对象没有共享状态与惰性消费机制

provenance.status: unified engineering vocabulary; no new classification-accuracy or repair-benefit claim

legacy_note: T1-T4 are historical routing groups; the five hypothesis templates and five question entries are not replacements for these seven obligation labels. No automatic legacy relabeling.
